saturation_policy.longitudinal_policy: A saturated task leaves the active discriminative aggregate only after every preregistered current-generation model family/configuration satisfies 5/5. Its task identity, outcomes, denominator and historical release memberships remain immutable in the longitudinal panel.

resource_calibration.claim_boundary: No runner calibration has been executed; this is a planned protocol only.

historical_policy.release_comparison_rule: Compare results only within compatible release inputs. Major agent-visible input changes require a new full rerun; minor verifier changes require regrade if raw artifacts are complete or affected-task rerun otherwise; patch metadata changes permit reuse only when evaluation-input digests are identical.

claim_boundary: Design-only initial CEB release policy. No benchmark task, grader, resource envelope, saturation state or runner has been qualified.
